ManipalCigna's Sarvah is a new health insurance solution designed to provide inclusive coverage. The term Sarvah translates to "For All," emphasizing the plan's commitment to affordability and accessibility.
On the other hand, ICICI Lombard Elevate is an unlimited health insurance plan offering unlimited sum insured options and access to infinite claim amounts through the Infinite Care benefit.
In this video, we compare both plans based on their features, unique selling points (USPs), eligibility criteria, and premiums.
